articleTitle: Research on the Internet of Things in the Automotive Industry
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: The rapid development of The Internet of things (hereinafter referred to as “IOT”) provides an opportunity for the informationization for the automotive industry. The introduction of the concept of the Internet of things in the automotive industry, will carry on the unified track, monitoring and managing and processing to the automobile entire manufacturing process as well as the post-sale socialized management related process, and has become a new trend. This article carries on the analysis and the research on the related question of automobile manufacturing “IOT”, and lists related content described in order to promote the realization of automotive informationization.

articleTitle: Realization of Individualized Recommendation System on Books Sale
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: In order to recommend potential books of interest to customers efficiently, this article applies the association rules in data mining to e-commerce business systems of book sales, designs an individualized recommendation system of book sales, and introduces the flow of the recommendation system and the specific realization procedures of data input, data preprocessing, association rules existence and individualized recommendation. Results show that the web site based on this article has shown great performance.

articleTitle: Research on an Optimized C4.5 Algorithm Based on Rough Set Theory
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: This paper proposes an improved algorithm based on the rough set theory and C4.5 decision tree. The algorithm uses rough set theory to reduce the attributes in the decision system, and uses the reduced data as the input of C4.5 algorithm to construct a decision tree. This article has put this new algorithm into practice, and the result of the experiment shows that the improved algorithm has higher efficiency and accuracy compared with the traditional C4.5 algorithm.

articleTitle: Research on Continuous Auditing Based on Multi-agent and Web Services
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: Continuous auditing technology is an important evolving branch of computer-assisted auditing technology. It gains high attention both from literature and industry because of the outstanding improvements it brings regarding the audit timeliness. This research reviews the three major types of continuous auditing architecture: EAM, ADM and ABM. This paper proposes a continuous auditing architecture based on multi-agent and web services (CAMAWS). The CAMAWS makes the execution of complex audit procedures easy, which is hard to execute in traditionally continuous auditing architecture. The costs of executing audit procedure also minimize, with specially designed functional modules to help manage the audit evidence, knowledge and detected abnormal behaviors. The CAMAWS shows a promising future of using multi-agent in continuous auditing to simulate the collaborative work of manual audit team.

articleTitle: Analysis of Security Models Based on Multilevel Security Policy
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: The core of the multilevel security policy is to divide information into different security levels, and to adopt different protection measures according to the security level. This policy is widely used in military field and business environment. This paper introduces three information security models based on multilevel security policy Bell-La Padula (BLP) model, Biba model and Clark-Wilson model. It emphatically expounds and compares the characteristics of the three models. At the end of this paper, the author analyzes the development trend of multilevel security models.

articleTitle: Secure E-business Transactions by Securing Web Services
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: Due to the popularity of internet and the growth of e-business, the world became very small. Everyday people are using internet as the medium of transaction of millions of dollars from one account to another. The web services are playing very crucial role in online transactions. That's why we have to think about the security of our entire transactions as well as web services. Web service transaction should be of major concern. Many technologies available which are providing web service facilities, for example java, .net etc. There are various options available to make web services secure. We can choose any options from protocols based, platform based or message based security. There are securities which can be IIS based, Asp.net based and SSL etc. Various threats to web services and e-business are also present. Threats like unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure of very important data, message reply etc. Anyone can hack the WSDL information and can get into downloadable files. While designing and developing the web services we have to think about code access security. In this .NET technology is being used for most of the examples. In this paper, the possibility of reducing the business cost through e-business is being explored.

articleTitle: Risk Assessment on Agricultural Products Logistics Financial Based on FAHP
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: Agricultural products logistics finance is a new variety of financial business in China's commercial banks. However, it still faces many challenges in the reality. In order to fill in the blank of new field, the model of evaluating agricultural products logistics financial risk was built in the paper using the method of Fuzzy Analytic Hierarchy Process (FAHP) on the basis of establishing agricultural products logistics financial risk factors. Through combined quantitative and qualitative methods, we had made comprehensive analysis and evaluation aimed at agricultural products logistics financial risk. The results showed that management mechanism was the main risk in numerous risk factors. So it is necessary to further analysis for these effects of agricultural products logistics financial business factors to decrease and avoid risk as far as possible. We hope that our work could help the banks reduce their financial risk. Moreover we try to bring forth suggestion for the agricultural products logistics financial market to develop healthily.

articleTitle: Research on the Model for Crop Water Requirements in Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: In order to accurately provide the extent of water requirement and thus to offer a scientific reference for the precision irrigation, we explored the application of wireless sensor networks to precision irrigation system. Data aggregation algorithm was adopted to improve the precision of the emission signal. Cluster-based and tree-based multi-hop routing algorithm was proposed to reduce energy consumption of node transmitting data. The analysis of the model based on machine learning enables user to precisely acquire the crop water requirement information and thus to implement the precision irrigation and then to lead to the improvement of the crop production.

articleTitle: Building a Tag Map for Recommendations in Microblogging
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: In its brief history of about two decades, the Web has evolved from a technical framework for information dissemination to more of an enabler of social interactions among its users. This weaves a huge virtual social network for users. Finding friends and targeting useful information are great challenges in such a complicated social network. Different with traditional content-based and collaborative information filtering techniques without considering social connections among users, we propose a naive recommendation approach utilizing user relationships to find friends and hot topics in social media. This is achieved by weaving a tag map from user preferences. Our experiments based on Microblogging data from Sina.com show a promising result in social media recommendation.

articleTitle: An Optimized SVM Model for Detection of Fraudulent Online Credit Card Transactions
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: In order to identify the credit card fraudulent transactions, in this paper we propose an optimized SVM model for detection of fraudulent online credit card model. The model use non-liner SVM and RBF for the sparse transaction data, and use grid algorithm to determine the optional combination of parameters. There dose not exist local minima problem, the curse of dimensionality, small sample size problem and nonlinear problem. In the experiment of the simulation environment, the proposed model performance better than other models which verifies its feasibility.

articleTitle: Genetic Optimization of BP Neural Network in the Application of Suspicious Financial Transactions Pattern Recognition
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: We explore and analyze the chaotic properties of the financial data, conduct classification learning in the financial transaction data. In this way, we are able to excavate the pattern and rule of customer transaction behavior, and isolate suspicious financial transactions. Using MATLAB to implement the programming of BP, we propose a genetic optimization of BP neural network to improve the defect of BP, which includes slow convergence and falling into local optimum easily. By using genetic algorithm to optimize the BP network, we are able to select the weight coefficient in a better way. Our experiments show that the optimized BP neural network function has a better predictive output.

Author Keywords: behavior patterns of suspicious financial transactions

articleTitle: Electronic Commerce Applications Based on Virtual Reality Technology
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: Many Internet users browse the e-commerce web pages but buy nothing. One of the important factors is that Internet users lost the shopping desire when they are facing the old e-commerce trading platform which consists of the list of good catalogue. So lots of people still like to go to the traditional shopping center. The most important characteristic of e-commerce is that people can buy all kinds of goods without leaving home. If we combine the 3D environment of traditional shopping mall with the e-commerce characteristics, it will induce people's shopping desire and give a new birth to the ecommerce. No doubt the virtual reality application in ecommerce is promising. As exploration, this article conceives a Web 3D shopping mall, discusses the application of virtual reality technology in the e-commerce, and describes the Web supporting technology at current stage.

articleTitle: Bayesian Network-Based Online Shopping Satisfaction Evaluation and Empirical Analysis of the Third-Party Logistics
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: Logistics plays an important role in electronic business activities, and logistics service satisfaction directly determines the consumer to the choice of logistics companies. In order to explore the factors affect logistics service satisfaction and the effect of various factors, this paper first integrated many scholars' views, and established a logistics satisfaction evaluation index system which is operable and tallied with the actual situation, Then, constructed an e-commerce third party logistics satisfaction assessment model using a Bayesian network based on the theory of Bayesian network. Finally, took the Shen Tong Express (STO) for an example and conducted empirical analysis of consumers of STO to acquire their satisfaction degree of the logistics service of STO as well as the order of importance of factors impacting logistics satisfaction.

articleTitle: Hybrid Approach Using RBR and CBR to Design an Automated Negotiation Model for Tourism Companies
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: The negotiation partners and contents between tourism service companies are changed relatively small and are easy to transform into rules and cases. Owing to these features, a new automated negotiation model integrating RBR and CBR technologies is proposed in this paper to improve the negotiation efficiency and success rate. For negotiations which have contract rules stored in rule base, the model will facilitate the automated negotiation process by employing the negotiation rules. The model will generate automated negotiation strategy from the negotiation case base when there are no contract rules existing. The system architecture, automated negotiation strategy and process, knowledge base for negotiation reasoning and core agents are elaborated in this paper.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of the Workflow Modeling
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: The workflow modeling is the basis of workflow management technology, the correctness and performance of the workflow model is the key to determining the success or failure of the workflow management system, this article is based on the research and analysis of the current popular workflow model, Further more, it gives Comparative analysis of workflow model based on Petri nets and workflow model based on UML, and through a case both during the modeling process mapping. And a case study described how to map a UML activity diagram to Petri net model, Finally, the paper gives the workflow simulation of Petri nets.

articleTitle: Vector Space Model Based Internet Contextual Advertising
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: Internet Advertising is a new branch and frontier subject. The commercial value of it increases dramatically recent years. To maximize the commercial value, it is necessary to bring advertisement to the audience who much possibly purchases. This advertising aim is so called accurate advertising and is the highest ideal of marketing. However, such marketing needs technical innovations. This paper proposes a Vector Space Model based Internet Contextual Advertising method which realize displaying advertisement impressions based on the web page contextual content. The experiments at the end of this paper also show its commercial applicability.

articleTitle: The Risk of Loan Consuming by SMEs Based on the Supply Chain
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: For the high bad-loan ratio of SMEs, banks are increasingly cautious to provide loans to SMEs. Based on the asymmetric information theory, we put forward the concept of "loan consuming radius (LCR)" from the depth dimension of supply chain. Then we characterize the loan risk of SMEs by this new concept.

articleTitle: Research on Location Based Service via Technology Acceptance Model
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: As one of the most widely used models in information systems research, the technology acceptance model (TAM) expresses the user's attitude and intention to accept a new information technology. Based on TAM, this study investigates the factors affecting people's attitude and behavioral intention of location based service (LBS), hypotheses and tests them. Finally summarized into conclusion and puts forward some suggestions.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Topology Structure of Network of Chinese Stock Market
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: In order to describe the network and topology structure of Chinese stock markets in a deep and vivid way, this paper selected 20 stocks belong to different sections of its trading days between May 3, 2011 to May 3, 2012 closing price (before recovery of the right) calculated as the basis to establish a stock market adjacency matrix. Firstly, by using the knowledge of mathematical statistics and algebra to get the related coefficient between two stocks and establish adjacent matrix. Secondly, the topology of the established network whose vertices are stocks and edges between vertices are the related coefficient of stocks is created by the Pajek software for the sake of simulating relatively real model for estimating stock network. Lastly, by calculating and using the main index which influence the network structure characteristics and dynamics features such as average path length, cluster coefficient and degree distribution to make a further analysis of the stock market network, which could provides some recommendations and actual of data as reference to China of stock market construction.

articleTitle: Research on the influence of online reviews on internet consumer purchasing decision
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: As an emerging platform for online shopping, online review changed the network consumer's purchase mode. In this paper, we study the effect of potential online purchaser influenced by the online reviews, by means of the questionnaire. The final study shows that: the Internet consumers when making purchase decisions are mostly affected by the average scores of products; and not significantly affected by the following three factors: the proportion of comment buyers accounted for all buyers, the sooner or later of online reviews and whether the contents reflecting the latest product information or not.

articleTitle: Research on the Integration Application of Business Intelligence and ERP
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: This paper analyzes the limitation of traditional ERP system, briefly introduces the ERP system and business intelligence technology, focus on the business intelligence technology and ERP system integration application architecture, discusses the various components, working process and its characteristics of the architecture, finally analyzes the complementary relationship between the ERP system and business intelligence technology.

articleTitle: Content-Based Recommendation Model in Micro-blogs Community
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: In this article, we present some novelty ideas to build a content-based recommendation system in micro-blogs community. We introduce a model to present users' preferences as a directed graph, named as "preference links", combining social relationships and people influences factors. Based on this model, we design an algorithm to collect recommendation candidates by visiting users' "preference links" and then generate a matrix to measure relevancies between content candidates and users' interests. A ranking function is proposed to rank these candidates based on the "relevancy matrix". We take the top items of the ranking results as the recommendation result. By implementing a prototype with these ideas in a real China micro-blogs community (Sina Weibo), our experiments show it can make personal recommendation with good accuracy.

articleTitle: Communication Performance Model in the Context of Social Communication Technology
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: Media have always been an important factor affecting communication. However, what kind of media can best improve communication performance is still to be answered. Based on Media Synchronicity Theory and Structural Holes Theory, a communication performance model, simultaneously considering people, media and task factors, is proposed. Besides traditional media, this study also take a new kind of media into account, social communication technologies(SCT). We argue it to be a completely different communication technology than others and have unique and multiple effects on communication process.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Sustainable Competitiveness of the Textile Industry Based on AHP
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: This dissertation has analyzed three aspects of the sustainable competitiveness of China's textile industry which includes competitiveness of talents, science and technology competitiveness and competitive power in the institutions. It has built an evaluation index system of sustainable competitiveness on textile industry. This system covers three major elements and twenty-four specific factors and adopts analytic hierarchy process (AHP) to analyze each index. The research has showed that the talent is the pacing factor which has affected the sustainable competitiveness of textile industry. All the researches are designed to provide decision support which can be applied to enhance the sustainable competitiveness of the textile industry.

articleTitle: An Improved Self-Adaptive Digital Watermarking Algorithm for RGB Images Based on W-SVD
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: In this paper, an improved and more robust digital image watermarking algorithm based on traditional W-SVD algorithm is proposed. We present a novel HVS-based watermarking scheme. Firstly, to increase robustness of the scheme, the watermark is refined by a watermark strength regulation factor. The factor is adjusted by the luminance sensitivity and texture complexity of G layer component of the host image. Then a secret message is scrambled using Arnold transform and modified into a watermark template. Finally, the watermark template will be embedded in the low-frequency coefficients of the host image, after a 2-level DWT handling. In comparison to the traditional W-SVD algorithm, our proposed algorithm has achieved significantly higher robustness against enhancement and noise addition attacks. Experimental results show that high imperceptibility is expected from the improved algorithm as well as higher robustness against common signal processing attacks.

articleTitle: Dynamic Performance Optimization of the Supply Chain with Nonlinear Constraints
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: The dynamic performance of supply chain system presents a characteristic of complexity in its stable region. It is important to coordinate and optimize the multi-dynamic performance of the supply chain system under the premise of ensuring its stability. Based on APIOBPCS, an index system of multi-dynamic performance is established. Thus, the system can achieve Pareto optimal via the Non-dominated Sorting Genetic Algorithm. According to the optimization and comparison of the three different nonlinear models on the basis of APIOBPCS, this paper summarizes the properties of Pareto frontier and solution sets. Moreover, the major influence of parameters on indexes is provided, and its inherent principle is explored through simulation experiments. Finally, managerial suggestions are proposed to improve the efficiency of supply chain on the basis of the research achievements.

articleTitle: Improved Web Page Watermarking
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: Web Page Watermarking is a research branch of the text watermarking. It is relatively difficult to embed the watermarking into the Web Page. For the particularity of the Web Page, this paper proposes an effectively improved Web Page Watermarking program which can not only protect the Web Page's completeness from tampering, but also can protect the whole Web site's copyright, integrity and consistency. This program, which can be effectively used for copyright protection, is able to test whether the Web Page suffers tampering, and to locate tampering.

articleTitle: A Method of XML Containing Data State in Emergency Plan Management Information System
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: In Web application system, the response time is one of the evaluating indicators of system performance, which is effected by many factors both software and hardware. Firstly, we propose a novel model to formalize text emergency plan of different kinds of crisis and emergency handling into a structuring dataset. Based on the data structure of emergency plan during development, we propose a method containing data state in XML to reduce server response time, when users edit data item located on a few of Web pages at a time. We test the response time using the data state method in Emergency Plan Management Information System.

articleTitle: An Electronic Document Tracking Method Based on Ant Colony Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: In view of the electronic file movement in the process of safety factor, identify key host classified electronic document processing, introduces an electronic document tracking method based on Ant Colony algorithm. Through the abstract analysis method, electronic document is abstracted as ants, key host is abstracted as path point, through associate the path and the trajectory, the problem of electronic document tracking is descripted as combinatorial optimization problem. To establish electronic document tracking model what based on the ant colony algorithm, and use the model to calculate the critical path which is processing the important electronic documents in the internal network. Simulation results show that the electronic document tracking method based on Ant Colony algorithm submitted in this article is very effective.

articleTitle: Study on Lifecycle-Derived Law of Internet Public Opinion in Public Crisis Affairs
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: The Internet has already become the vigorous development of the 'fourth media' after the appearance of the three traditional media: a newspaper, radio and television. With this platform, many crisis events have the rapidly spread and attention since they have been put forward. Therefore, public opinion crisis is a focus that many scholars are attending on. Public crisis of the network public opinion cycle evolution is the inherent law of the network spread public opinion, it researches quantitatively that its cycle evolution is the public opinion crisis management rules of the premise and guarantee. In this paper, it researches quantitatively the public crisis network of public opinion cycle evolution rule with the typical public crisis of network public opinion case as samples. The results of the study show that: public opinion news triggered crisis index in 71.42. Before the index is the incubation period, after the index is the outbreak period, Official results response to the crisis triggered index in 57.97. Before the index is the outbreak period, after the index is the subside period.

articleTitle: Research on Dynamic Allocation Based on Carbon Management Certification
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: Based on the project of Low Carbon City in China, which is sponsored by World Wildlife Fund (WWF), it is imperative to find a low carbon development approach in China. To achieve the low carbon goal, it is important to measure and control carbon emission. In this paper, the content of carbon resource footprint and carbon management capability are described. A carbon coordinate system, including share, replacement, recovery and recycle, is established. Research on quality engineering for carbon footprint is discussed. In this way, a strong technical support to systematically study the approach for low carbon resource is provided.

Author Keywords: carbon footprint; engineering control; measurement of carbon emission

articleTitle: Supplier Control and Firm Performance in Service Supply Chain: The Role of Cooperation Risk and Knowledge Sharing Intention
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: This study examines the relationship between supplier control and firm performance and the role of knowledge sharing intention and cooperation risk. Using data collected from China Mobile, we demonstrate that formal control and social control are both positively related to supplier's knowledge sharing intention, but negatively related to cooperation risk. We also find that supplier's knowledge sharing intention is positively related to firm performance and cooperation risk is negatively related to firm performance, which means supplier's knowledge sharing intention and cooperation risk are mediated between supplier control and firm performance. And theoretical and managerial implications are discussed.

articleTitle: The Exploration for Using E-commerce Platform to Optimize Insurance Business
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: This article analyzes the insurance business model, and points out the future direction and content for the existing insurance business. Based on the analysis, the article introduces the e-commerce platform to improve and optimize the traditional insurance business model, and gives a number of related recommendations.

articleTitle: Improving M-commerce through Enterprise Mobility
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: M-Commerce has been recognized as a key driving force of next generation e-commerce. Enterprise mobility is the trend of mobilized business processes and exploits new revenue streams. Mobility offers new possibilities to businesses, but the path to mobility is full of significant challenges. For the purpose of successful implementation on enterprise mobility, enterprises should identify all key factors and have right attitude toward the challenges of mobility. This paper discusses the challenges of enterprise mobility, and identifies all key factors of implementation on enterprise mobility in details. Meanwhile, paper makes an analysis that provides insights into the enterprise mobility benefits and explores new trends for scholars and practicing managers.

articleTitle: Research on Recommendation Model of Technology Literature Based on User Preference
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: How to describe the features of users 'literature searching behavior has much more influences upon the efficiency of literature recommendation. Based on analyzing three key literature searching behavior, we assign several weight for those behavior so as to evaluate users' preferences. And then propose a user preference based recommendation model. Through simulation experiment, it is proved that our model had good performance and could improve the literature service quality effectively.

articleTitle: Network Human Resources Platform Strategies Research with Two-Sided Market Theory
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: The network human resources platform has become an indispensable part of modern human resource management over the past few years and shows tremendous promise of growth even in the future. At the same time, more and more academics have spent much time and effort debating topics of this field. However, as to network human resources industry with typical two-sided market characteristics, many problems cannot be tackled based upon traditional economic theory. With the two sided market theory, this article will develop a pricing and profit maximization model for monopoly platform by analyzing the morphology and characteristics of China's network human resources platform, examine the influencing factors for business strategies and industry access etc, and provide advices for enterprises ' competition strategies making.

articleTitle: Can Average Score of Online Reviews Reveal Product's Real Quality?
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: As the new platform in e-commerce, online reviews change the purchase means of Internet consumers. Therefore, it is important to analyze the influence of online reviews on consumer purchase decisions in order to enhance the penetration ratio of Internet consumers in internet users of China. To further verify whether the product's average scores can reveal the true quality of products, using empirical analysis and mathematical modeling methods, the paper makes a statistical description for the data about business war stories, home video and the bar phone on Amazon during from January to February of 2010. Finally, we found average score of online reviews may mislead the consumer purchasing decisions and give the rationalization proposals to Internet retailers and consumers, while noting the contributions and deficiencies of this article, and discusses the future research directions.

articleTitle: The Effect of Demand Information on Carbon Emission in Low Carbon Green Supply Chain
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government

articleTitle: Study of Authentication Mechanism of E-evidence in the E-commerce Litigation
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: E-commerce has a great impact on burden of proof and cross-examination, etc, in the traditional evidence rules. After analyzing the cross-examination and certification obstacles encountered during e-commerce disputes, the paper proposes an authentication mechanism of e-evidence combined with network security audit system. Based on graph theory, the mechanism constructs a chain of evidence fragment for a lawsuit to authenticate e-evidence. Experiment is performed to validate the effectivity of proposed mechanism, which can improve the adoption rate as direct evidence in judicial decisions.

articleTitle: Based on the Outskirts of Beijing Cultural Tourism Development of the Tourist Market-Oriented Probe -- Analysis about the Artistic Conception Tourism Analysis of the Shangzhuang-Nalan Culture Park
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: Through comprehensive analysis of the Nalan cultural industrial park development advantages, weaknesses, opportunities and challenges as well as the development of cultural industry park in Nalan can bring benefits, analog and analysis of domestic and foreign industrial park construction and development models, on the basic concept and preliminary design of the implementation of the program of the Shangzhuang Nalan culture industry park. This research, including the general idea, image positioning, marketing strategy, can be inspired and learn from the development of all parts of the country.

articleTitle: Research on Human Capital in Knowledge-Intensive Business Services
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: Knowledge-intensive business services are the main participants in the knowledge-based economy. Knowledge creation, spread and accumulation are strategic methods for KIBS to remain competitive. For KIBS, the achievement of its value is based on activities of its staff, namely, the knowledge workers. Human capital is an important index of KIBS' competitiveness. This paper analyze the Characteristics of human capital in KIBS, Staff role conversion mode and team management mode.

articleTitle: Design of Original Search Model Based on Broadcast and DHT in Peer to Peer Environment
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: The file retrieval based on key words in P2P network is a challenging problem. In this paper, we propose a new solution: the search model identifies the frequency of key words automatically and applies inverted index based on DHT to fetch the sparse key words, the model can judge adopting whether inverted index or broadcast search under the condition of basing on key words retrieval, when fetch frequent key words, the model improves the broadcast algorithm in P2P system and adopts pointer of DHT to avoid repetitive messages.

articleTitle: Interests Distribution Mechanism of Passenger Travel Organizing Model Based on Tourism Industry Chain
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: The organization model optimization of the tourist passenger transport is one of most active areas in relevant fundamental research field at present. Although the fundamental research achievement is rich, it has not been received the desired effect in reality, and the feasibility is not strong. This article proposes the organization model of “the tourist passenger transport enterprise + travel agency”. According to the mode, the tourist passenger transport enterprise will establish a cooperation relationship with travel agency, and travel agency organizes tourists and the tourist passenger enterprise transports tourists. And then the article proposes interest distribution mechanism during the cooperation. It will provide a viable development strategy of passenger travel enterprise and travel agency.

articleTitle: Research on the Construction of Logistics Finance Information System
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: From the logistics service extension to the logistics finance business, and gradually formed logistics finance information system. This paper discusses the related concepts of logistics finance, on the basis of analysis of the market status, put forward the logistics finance business is the urgent demand of the development of modern logistics. Study on the difficulties in the development of logistics finance information system, including function scale, demand analysis, system construction and business process reengineering equilibrium problem, interface problem of logistics finance information system. Focus on the construction of basic method and process, must consider the characteristics of basic framework, system structure of logistics finance information system. Logistics finance information system structure includes the strategy and development subsystem, information management subsystem, system settings subsystem, operation management subsystem, business management subsystem, related business subsystem, business supervision subsystem, finance management subsystem, risk management subsystem, decision-making analysis subsystem. Enterprises through the help of logistics finance business information system, consolidate the old customer relationship, open up new service market, become business and profit a new growth point. Finally summarizes the problem of logistics finance information system and the direction of further development.

articleTitle: Improving WTLS Protocol Using Identity-Based Cryptography
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: IBC is emerging as an important contender to traditional public key cryptography for its attractive properties. But the Wireless Transport Layer Security (WTLS) protocol does not support it at present. To resolve this problem, an improved WTLS protocol based on IBC (IB_WTLS) is proposed. Firstly, new cipher suits are designed for WTLS protocol, which give support to IBC scheme. Secondly, the IBC-based authentication is implemented by using IBC public-keys instead of X.509 public-keys. At last, IB_WTLS protocol message architecture is improved by defining a set of entity interaction operation sequences. The results show that IB_WTLS have advantages of lightweight and efficiency of IBC, as well as easy to deploy.

articleTitle: Research on Contribution of Information Productivity to Economic Growth
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: This paper measures the contribution of information productivity to the economic growth by a revised Cobb-Douglas production function which takes capital, labor and information as three elements. The result shows that information productivity contributes the most to the economic growth. Meanwhile, we also compare China with other high income countries and find that information input has stronger multiplier effect in China than high income countries.

articleTitle: Research on Temperature Control Algorithm Based on Outlier Mining in RFID
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: Using data mining approach to handle real-time RFID temperature data can effectively achieve automatic real time monitoring of temperature. The FAM algorithm proposed by the paper which uses the two properties of global approximation outlier degrees and local approximate outliers to realize the pruning of the RFID temperature data sets. The experimental results demonstrate that when handling the cold chain temperature data, the algorithm can reduce user dependence, decrease the complexity of the algorithm and improve the accuracy. It is an effective solution to the problem of processing massive data by the use of RFID technology.

articleTitle: Improvement and Implementation of RBAC Access Control Model
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: As the scale of E-commerce expands, the Role Based Access Control (RBAC) model has tremendous role and complexity. This paper defines User Group Role (UGR) and improves the RBAC model. It also includes the regulation, design and description under XACML framework. The modified RBAC is implemented by Java.

articleTitle: A Reseach Review of E-government Systems Outsourcing
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: Based on reviewing and inducing the domestic and overseas research achievements, this article detailedly analyzed causes, modes and risks of e-government system outsourcing. The causes mainly include financial cost, strategy and IT ablity. The modes are BOT, BOO and BT. According to IT outsourcing, a risk factor framework is built to show e-government systems outsourcing risks.

articleTitle: A Secure Roaming Payment Protocol in Mobile Commerce
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: During the last few years, it has become more and more conpeling in mobile commerce applications, mobile commerce technology is convenient, but also produces a series of security compromise. Payment is an important part of the network security. In this paper, we proposed a secure roaming payment protocol based on IBS, which considers effective mutual authentication between customer and the forge in domain bank and realizes roaming payment. Based on IBS signature, a signature and verification scheme is designed in one round mutual authentication and roaming payment. Security analysis shows, basing on the security of IBS, the proposed protocol with universally compos able(UC)model", "it proves that the proposed protocol satisfies the definition of UC security defined in the UC model. scheme is sufficient for private key privacy, signature unforgeability.

articleTitle: Research on Enhancement of the Service Outsourcing Enterprises' Innovation Ability Based on the Absorption Capacity
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: The absorptive capacity is a key factor to enhance the impact of service outsourcing enterprises' innovation ability. This paper analyzes the innovation capability of service outsourcing enterprises the necessity of absorptive capacity and service outsourcing innovation capability, the establishment of a model based on the enhancement of the absorptive capacity of the service outsourcing enterprises' innovation ability, and in order to service outsourcing enterprises innovation capability provides some feasible proposals. These provide guidance for the development of China's service outsourcing industry.

articleTitle: Review of Forming Model of Emerging Industries Driven by Information Technology
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: Further informationization, especially the new generation of information technology and the wide use of Internet have promoted the industrial integration and innovation, which contribute to appearance of the emerging industries. In this paper, related theories for formation model of emerging industries that is driven by domestic and foreign information technology are arranged in proper order. Namely, the paper systematically reviews the theories and practice about industries merging and innovation promoted by information technology. It has significant for us to study on the development of strategic emerging industries.

articleTitle: The Use of Compound Real Option Design and Evaluation to Control the Risk in Patent Financing Project
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: Efficient risk control is one of the key factors for the success of patent financing project. By using compound real option method, this paper studies the risk control of patent financing project from the angle of project design. The content includes risk analysis, the construction of compound real option and the evaluation of compound real option. The modified compound real option evaluation method is proposed. The improved method was applied in some project design and the order preference of plan is attained, and the ideal plan is ascertained.

articleTitle: Countermeasure Study on E-government in China on the View of Public Satisfaction
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: E-Government is a important topic in recent years, many Chinese scholars did a lot of research on it. Though most of them acknowledged that one of the most critical purposes is to make public feel satisfied, less literature referred to the egovernment on the view of public satisfaction. According to some foreign theories, this article concludes some impacts on public satisfaction to e-government and researches on the problems and some countermeasures on the purpose of promoting the constructing of China's e-government.

articleTitle: Internet News Aided Evaluation of China's Housing Market
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: China's housing (real estate) market is booming fast in the past decade and many researchers try to analyze the housing economy and propose measures to put it under control. In this work, we evaluate China's housing market from a novel view of Internet news of Sina in 2001-2011. We compare our results with the major historical events and economic data, and we also study peoples' opinions based on the news. Our main observations are as follows. First, the market condition evaluated from Sina news is quite correlated to that of historical events and economic data. Second, peoples' expectations are basically in accordance with government attitudes. Third, the expectations of price rising and falling are comparable in amount. It can explain psychologically why China's housing market is booming on the whole although people think the price is high. Our work may suggest that our society should continue to take steps economically and politically to change peoples' mind from buying houses eagerly with the expectation of price rising soon so as to cool the market. Besides, this work shows an example that we can derive faithful market evaluations from the information of trustable websites.

articleTitle: Research of E-commerce Supply Chain Management with CreditRisk + Model
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: Credit Risk + model, which proposed firstly in 1997 is a helpful tool to simulate the distribution of loss allocation of electronic supply chain enterprises. It not only benefits to existing customer relationship, but also provides faster, cheaper products advertisement customer development and cultivate their bonds of satisfaction and loyalty, retain customers. The following article focuses on the calculation of fraud order probability and fraud order loss by using Credit Risk + model, and demonstrates an example of real company.

articleTitle: Research on Mood Perception of Microblog Data Flow
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: This study improve the corpus of emotional perception on the basis of existing research on the data flow of microblog, and use the new corpus to calculate the emotional perception. Design a model and an algorithm to calculating emotional perception of microblog, as well as considered to the short text of microblog. On this basis, use Java computer language programming in the My Eclipse software environment, so that the algorithm can be achieved. Finally, we can get an accurate emotional curve of microblog by collating and calculating the data flow of microblog.

articleTitle: Service-Oriented Integration Framework
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: With the continuous development of enterprise information, the way that develop software first and then integrated makes the system difficult to extend. This way of working will lead to secondary long development cycle, applications are not flexible, and can not take full advantage of existing IT assets. SOA has been fused developing and integrated, which diminishes the differences of various practical systems and realizes the EAI function with low cost as well as comprehensive systems. In this paper, foreign currency trading system is an example. We will discuss how to use Web Services technology to achieve service-oriented systems integration, Based on the guarantee of the optimized realization of different subsystem, they can be connected with each other, and meet the requirements of the corporation information and resources sharing in maximized level, so as to make the system highly expanding and Reusing.

articleTitle: Research on E-commerce Applied Talent Training in Higher Vocational Colleges
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: With the rapid development of Electronic Commerce, the society requires an increasing number of Electronic Commerce talents. The main task of higher vocational education is to provide for the society all sorts of talents with high application skills as soon as possible and serve the development of social economy. This paper analyzes the status of e-commerce professional training in higher vocational colleges, and proposes ideas and solutions for the lack of Electronic Commerce curriculum, provides help for the training of e-commerce applied talents.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of E-commerce Professional Employee Needs and University Curriculum Setting
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: With the rapid development of e-commerce industry, the employment demands is growing strongly. In contrast with this, the difficult employment situation of e-commerce graduates has become increasingly prominent. The paper conducts an analysis, by applying web techniques, to reveal that the current universities' e-commerce curriculum exist some deviation with the recruitment needs. Then, we put forward some suggestions on universities' e-commerce curriculum.

articleTitle: Research on Bilateral Market Pricing Strategies for Trading Platform of Digital Media Content Products
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: The trading platform of digital media content products has the characteristics of bilateral markets, which could connect the providers and demanders through the platform, so that to provide trading services for them and earn corresponding benefit. The thesis studies the bilateral market structure, characteristic, and pricing-influencing elements of digital media content product trading platform, and on this basis puts forward pricing strategies of bilateral trading platform of digital media content products in user-gathering stage and stable-developing stage.

articleTitle: Domestic E-commerce Research Topics Evolution Analysis
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: The paper conducts a domestic E-Commerce research topics evolution statistical analysis based on 139 E-Commerce related literature published in 12 different core journals during 2006 to 2010 and explores the evolution process of E-Commerce research topics through perspectives of year distribution, author distribution, source journals distribution, keywords distribution and research topics distribution. This paper also concludes the following three main aspects: 1.the amount of E-Commerce related literature is decreasing year by year during 2006 to 2010;2. There are steady research journals and researchers in ecommerce, 3. E-Commerce research is relatively concentrated.

articleTitle: Analysis on the Impact of Short-Selling Mechanism to Chinese Stock Markets Based Complex Network Theory
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: A series of financial measures truly ended the unilateral history in Chinese stock markets in 2010. Our empirical study on the MST and threshold network model of CSI 300. The result shows that the whole network presents more loosely under the influence of short-selling mechanism The work of this paper riches the theoretical explanations and expands the application fields.

articleTitle: Research on the Profit Modes and Issues of Chinese Group-Buying Websites
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: Nowadays, electronic commerce (e-commerce) in China is just developing at a high speed. Its rapid development has brought about many new shopping ways. Currently, the very promising online buying way is group buying, or Tuangou, mainly due to its low price. However, recent statistics has showed that there is a big decline in domestic online group buying industry. About half of group-buying websites have shut down. In this paper, to find out the reason why the industry is bleak, firstly we study the profit modes of Chinese group-buying websites, and then some issues are presented, and in the end we propose some advice.

articleTitle: Price-Matching for Sales Service Coordination with Free-Riding between Retailers
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: This paper studies sales service coordination for a dual-channel supply chain, where an online retailer offers a lower price and free-rides a brick-and-mortar retailer's sales service. The free riding action reduces brick-and-mortar retailer's desired service level, and hurts the manufacturer's profit and the overall supply chain performance. To achieve sales service coordination, we designed a contract with price match and selective compensation rebate.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Impact of Social Network on College Students -- An Empirical Study of renren.com
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: In order to research the impact on college students, a research value and application analysis of renren.com has been done first. Second, the author designed a questionnaire about the usage of 'renren.com' and tested the reliability and validity of the questionnaire. A series of important conclusions and findings are achieved through the analysis of survey. Then, the evolution of impact is established that 'Available Resources - Public Opinion - Behavior Change', the level of impact is measured of three levels using data from previous survey. In the empirical research, some political suggestions are put up considering the development status and trend of SNS, which has a strong practical value.

articleTitle: Design of a Recommendation System Based on Top-k Query in a Pure P2P Environment
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: At present, most peer-to-peer file sharing systems provide file-mark-based searching function. In the paper, we offer a file recommendation system based on pure peer-to-peer system, use the TOPK method to find similar interest peers in a way to realize the interest-based self-adaptive adjustment of network topology, and exploits the recommendation information between users with similar interest to achieve the high-efficiency searching of files in the network.

articleTitle: A Novel LSB Matching Steganalysis Detection Algorithm Based on Characteristics of the Second Order Difference Markov
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: For the LSB matching steganography with high security, the author has calculated the second-order differential of the image pixels on horizontal and vertical directions, obtaining the differential matrix and taking it as sensitive feature extracting source. Then, by extracting the second-order Markov transformation matrix of the differential matrix as the features, this paper proposed a LSB matching steganalytic algorithm. Experimental results show that: compared with existing algorithm, the proposed algorithm can not only preserve the high detection accuracy, but also speedup the detection process in a large extent, which enhance the performance and practicability of the steganalytic algorithm.

articleTitle: Knowledge Innovation System and Customer Impact of Knowledge-Intensive Business Services
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: Following the development of economy, the service industry has already exceeded the manufacturing industry and has been one country's leading industry. Providing knowledge is the service way of Knowledge-Intensive business services (KIBS). KIBS are the important branch in the service industries. Through knowledge sharing, knowledge shifting, developing and using the knowledge of enterprises deeply, KIBS have promoted the knowledge innovation activities of one's own and other customer enterprises, have taken on the important role in the whole innovative system. Based on the product characteristics of KIBS, this dissertation discusses KIBS knowledge source and its influence to customers' innovation course, and then provides its whole knowledge innovation system and course model.

articleTitle: Analyzing Semantic Heterogeneity in XBRL Taxonomies: An Ontology Perspective
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: Extensible Business Reporting Language (XBRL) is a standard for the electronic exchange of data between businesses and on the Internet. XBRL Taxonomies are the dictionaries which the language uses. Many different organizations, including regulators, specific industries or even companies, may require their own taxonomies to cover their business reporting needs. They are generally heterogeneous, which severely hampers the interoperability and comparability of the XBRL instances. This paper first gives the representation of a taxonomy using formal ontology. Then we define the concept-level semantic differences between Chinese two taxonomies which is developed by Shanghai Stock Exchange and Shen Zhen Stock Exchange, respectively. There are label and meaning conflictions, which can be resolved through concept mapping. This paper could be a basis to reconcile semantic conflictions among heterogeneous taxonomies.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis about Chinese Service Industry Manufacturization
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: The paper focus on the theme of service industry manufacturization which ignored by academic circle, service industry used a great deal of high-technology or equipment to improve its own efficiency. We measure the degree of service industry manufacturization through the input-output table, on the basis we using the panel data and regression method to analysis the manufacturization impact on the total service industry performance. The result show: The service performance of service and manufacturization degree is high positive correlation, manufacturization is a key power promote service industry development, moreover, urbanization rate and service quality of personnels are also important to the service industry development. At last, we provide some implications of development of service industry.

articleTitle: A Social Label Automatic Tagging Based Method on Situation Semantics in Web Service Discovery
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: The traditional approach to describe web services using ontology is a departure from the perspective of web service provider which can not ensure high precision and recall ratios, that is the consistency of the service designing intent and the service using intent, the conformance of the excepted using environment and the actual using environment, and the possibility of being detected by potential users. In this paper, a social label automatic tagging based method on situation semantics in web service discovery is proposed, which takes into account both semantic web technology and user situation semantics.

articleTitle: Design of SF6 Gas Characters Monitoring System Based on GPRS
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: In this design, developers use technology of GPRS and embedded system to monitor density and humidity of sulfur hexafluoride in electric equipment directly based on the GPRS and the Internet. In this paper developers introduce the application and relevant technology of GPRS used in the electric power system. And the design resolved the problem of wireless monitoring of unmanned transformer.

articleTitle: Game Analysis of Harnessing Collusion in the Government Procurement Field
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: The supervision of collusion behavior in the government procurement is discussed in this paper. The parallel collusion game model between suppliers and the vertical collusion game model between suppliers and procurement departments are respectively constructed. The Nash equilibrium solution of the parallel collusion model is analyzed. For no Nash equilibrium in the vertical collusion game model, then the mixed strategy equilibrium is analyzed. The relations between the monitoring and inspecting probability, punishment (fines and long-term loss) and collusion strategy are explained. The exchangeability between monitoring strategy and punishment is verified. Summarize models' optimal strategy solution, and on this basis, point out relevant policy suggestions.

articleTitle: Sense the Words: The Impact of Discussion Board Postings on the Stock Market
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: Some empirical studies claim that postings in the stock message board have a small but significant correlation on stock return. We study the effect of 2.85 million postings of 58 representative listed firms in HS300 index in China. Instead of considering daily postings as a whole, we divide daily postings into five intervals according to text length. We find that the magnitude of correlation between postings and stock return varies by the number of words, i.e., short postings have positive correlations, more words are negative and longest postings have positive correlation again.

articleTitle: Visualization Analysis of Hot Spot and Cutting-Edge about Communities of Practice
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: This paper retrieves source data on the theme of communities of practice from ISI Web of Knowledge database, and uses the software of Cite Space II to draw the map of communities of practice domain about national or regional distribution, classic works, hot-spot and cutting-edge research content, then makes specific analysis. It is found that there is a wide range of collaborative research developed in the America, Britain, Canada, Singapore, Israel and New Zealand, and the output of the papers of each country is very rich. The hot and cutting-edge research fields are divided into two aspects including the basic theories of communities of practice and the knowledge management in communities of practice, which main content is about the definition, the function, the principle of construction of communities of practice and knowledge sharing in the communities of practice.

articleTitle: Co-word Analysis of Domestic Network Virtual Society Research Hotspots and Evolution
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: As a new social formation, network virtual society has become one of the work on the governments close to the strategic management. This paper aims at through collection china journals network in the related network virtual society of academic papers, uses co-word analysis and visual method, combs domestic network virtual society research choroids, analysis the research area theme and hot, summary theme evolution situation, provides a certain theory reference and experience for comprehensive and system to research network virtual society development law, exploring network virtual society management theory and policy issues.

articleTitle: Neural Network Based Attention Degree Prediction for Internet Incidents in One-Crest Period
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: Observing an Internet incident, we find that its attention degrees develop in multiple wave crests. We propose a basic model to predict the trend of one wave crest based on back propagation (BP) neural network. Simulation experiments show that our model can predict one-crest trend of an Internet incident under the assumption that its maximum attention degree can be estimated. Our work can serve as an auxiliary tool for social or commercial workers to make decisions based on public opinions.

articleTitle: Game Theory Based Cooperation Incentive Mechanism in Vehicular Ad Hoc Networks
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: Nowadays, Vehicular Ad hoc Network (VANET) emerges as a special and typical form of Internet of Things. VANETs are very useful for decreasing collision accidents and increasing passenger safety. In VANETs the communication between vehicles needs the help of other vehicles with forwarding data packets hop-by-hop. However, a vehicle may be unwilling to help other vehicles to forward packets. For it would cost its computing and communicating resource. And every vehicle is rational. They all want to maximize their utility. Thus, it is necessary to consider seriously how to motivate vehicles to cooperate with each other to relay packets in the communications of vehicle-to-vehicle and vehicle-to-roadside. In this paper we propose a cooperation incentive mechanism based on game theory. The existence and uniqueness of a Nash Equilibrium is proved. And the results of simulation demonstrate that the mechanism we proposed can greatly stimulate the vehicles to actively participate in the packet forwarding, and it is helpful in improving the performance of the VANETs.

articleTitle: Impact of Online Review on Sales: An Empirical Investigation of Experience Products with Different Popularities
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: As E-Commerce becomes a trend and habit in people's lives, online reviews have become a useful marketing tool and important factor of business success. Based on recent research, this paper categorizes experience products into popular and less popular classes, and makes an empirical study on online reviews on sales for different popularity products. Through collecting data on dangdang.com, and linear regression and empirical analysis, this paper gets the conclusion that comparing to popular products, less popular products' sales were more easily affected by online reviews. The B2C companies could optimize their marketing strategy by encouraging users to remark more on less popular goods. On the other hand, this paper contributes to the online review area on the idea of categorizing products and making analysis respectively.

articleTitle: An Anonymization Method Based on Tradeoff between Utility and Privacy for Data Publishing
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: Privacy preserving is an important issue in data publishing. Many anonymization algorithms are available in meeting the privacy requirements of the privacy models such as k-anonymity, l-diversity and t-closeness. In this paper, we discuss the requirements that anonymized data should meet and propose a new data anonymization approach based on tradeoff between utility and privacy to resist probabilistic inference attacks. To evaluate the quality of anonymized results, a method of measuring the utility loss and privacy gain of anonymized data is brought out which can be used to find the optimal anonymization solution. The result of the experiments validates the availability of the approach.

articleTitle: Information Security Risk Assessment Model of IT Outsourcing Managed Service
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: With the rapid development of the IT services outsourcing industry, information security issues have become increasingly prominent. Information security risk assessment is an important part of IT outsourcing management. In this paper, risk matrix method is used in the information security risk assessment of IT services outsourcing. By constructing expert two-dimensional matrix, Borda sequencing and AHP analytic hierarchy process method, the qualitative process will be quantified, and the objectivity of the assessment will be further enhanced.

articleTitle: Understanding the Role of Technical Features and Network Effects in Explaining Microblogging Acceptance
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: The popularity of microblogging has drawn an increasing amount of attention from users keen to expand friendship, facilitate information sharing and seeking. Given the extensive use of microblogging services, there is a pressing need to understand user acceptance behavior in microblogging services. Although there are few studies exploring the factors underlying popular or successful microbloggings, none of research has been reported from both of the technical features and network effects of microblogging services. This study extended motivational model with sense of belonging as a theoretical framework to examine the role of technical features and network effects in explaining microblogging acceptance. We proposed five external variables and divided them into two contexts, the technical feature context and network effect context. These two contexts were modeled to influence the perceived usefulness, perceived enjoyment, sense of belonging and behavioral intention constructs. The findings of this research provide directions for system administrators and service providers to achieve higher levels of microblogging usage by developing multi-faceted strategies.

articleTitle: A Novel Usability Matrix for ERP Systems Using Heuristic Approach
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: There are two types of systems, computerized and socio-technical systems. Socio-technical systems are complex and deals with technical operations by involving users. The usability is the study that discusses the user philosophy in Socio-technical systems. It is very older term and previously named as software psychology. It debates on diverse variables that help to improve the software usability. The continuous changes in user' demands, situations, and environment also have deep impact on software usability. These changes acquire experts and developers intention to gather more and more humans' factors. In this extended paper we proposed a usability heuristic for the appraisal to the context of ERP applications. Enterprise resource planning system (ERP) used to manage business-processes and to provide past records for decision-making. The proposed heuristic for evaluation is based on qualitative review of previous literature. Beside literature the series of empirical studies were also conducted by segregating the user' on the bases of their roles in organization.

articleTitle: The Effectiveness and Limitations of Internet Anti-corruption: A Perspective of Institutional Analysis
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: Internet anti-corruption is the product of the development and popularization of the Internet and it is a new form of anti-corruption, including civil and official levels. Nongovernmental anti-corruption has mainly taken the form of internet reports and exposure, governmental internet anticorruption includes the passive response to the internet of public opinion and active use of internet anti-corruption, the former follows the pressure mode, the latter is the active mode. Based on the perspective of institutional analysis, we can better understand the effectiveness and limitation of internet anti-corruption. The nature of the technical framework of the internet which is known as the media system, power system determines the effectiveness of the internet against corruption, but also determines the limitations of internet anti-corruption. The full effectiveness of Internet anti-corruption depends on strengthening the positive interaction of non-governmental anti-corruption and official anticorruption, and integrating the system and mechanism of civil anti-corruption and official anti-corruption.

articleTitle: Research on XML Element Search Results Clustering
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: Clustering XML search results is an effective way to improve performance. However, the key problem is how to measure similarity between XML documents. This paper studies XML search results clustering based on element granularity and proposes one similarity measurement method. The method firstly uses latent semantic indexing technology(LSI) to obtain term semantics and then combines the XML element node content and semantic structure properties(CASS). To evaluate clustering performance, two new performance evaluation methodologies, namely R_ClusterRatio and R_DocuRatio are introduced. It is motivated by the observations of relevant documents distribution and the fact that the experiment data collection, IEEE CS corpus, do not provide classification information. Experiment results show that proposed similarity method combining term semantics with content and structure semantics integration(LSI-CASS) is feasible, and it produces better clustering quality than LSI-CAS.

articleTitle: Research for Promoting Employment of Minimum Livelihood Guarantee Citizens for Beijing
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: Based on the people who under the minimum livelihood guarantee system for urban residents in Beijing, this paper closely surrounds the research project that the promotion of employment and re-employment. Focusing on the current questions and various perplexities in the procession of employment and re-employment in which people set, the paper tends to try its best to trace an effective way to promote the employment and re-employment. In addition, this paper pays much attention to the reality and validity of the demands of encouraging Minimum livelihood guarantee citizens to be employed or re-employed. This article also bring about applicable and feasible measure and suggestion about this program.

Author Keywords: minimum livelihood guarantee system for urban residents
promotion of the employment and re-employment

articleTitle: Empirical Study Based on ARMA-GARCH Tempered Stable Lévy Processes: Evidence from Chinese Financial Markets
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: This paper develops the ARMA-GARCH model and obtain the historical filtered noise sequence based on time series analysis of Shanghai Composite Index (SHI). Then, it estimates the parameters of noise using method of moments estimation and simulates TS measure applying sequence representation method. Further, it fits the noise distribution and tailed distribution employing normal distribution and α - stable distribution, classical tempered stable (CTS) distribution and rapidly decreasing tempered stable (RDTS) distribution, respectively. The empirical results are as follows. Firstly, the random residual noise sequence presents leptokurtic, skewed and heavy-tailed characteristics in Chinese financial markets. Secondly, tempered stable (TS) distribution fits tailed distribution well under the method of moments estimation and exhibits the characteristics of rapidly decreasing jump. Thirdly, the probability of extreme events is 5 times in TS process than that of the normal process, which is in line with markets and be closed to the annual average frequency of Chinese financial markets' turmoils.

articleTitle: The Drives of E-Marketplace Adoption in China: The Mediation Effect of Trust
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: Many businesses now have been launched e-business directly within the Internet era and thus have a born-in global reach, however In China, there are many bottlenecks in the infrastructure or hardware of global e-commerce, or e-trade, whereas some e-marketplaces, such as Alibaba.com, have thrived. E-MP plays as Intermediary are a primary subject in the field of global e-business management. The principal objective of this study was to test empirically the driving factors of adoption of e-marketplace in China, based on the structural equation modeling (SEM). The results indicate that the trust variable holds the full meditation effect between support policy and e-MP use. Support policy will affect the use of e-mp only via the meditation effect of trust. The trust variable also shows the partial meditation effect between web capacity and e-MP use. We can find that there are some missing link between the supporting policy and the real adoption of e-MP. Some policy implications are also proposed. Roles of intermediary are suggested that is facilitator, collaborator, and web-service provider.

Author Keywords: electronic-based export intermediary firms (e-EIFs); trust; structural equation model (SEM)

articleTitle: Table of contents
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Management of e-Commerce and e-Government
abstract: The following topics are dealt with: e-commerce; information security; risk management; Web 2.0; social media; enterprise information systems; knowledge management; business intelligence; e-government; e-governance; services management and operations management.
